title: PACE: Research Proving Agent for Adaptive Conjecture Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2610.33690v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many mathematical research agents focus on solving problems with fixed statements. However, conjecture research, especially in applied mathematics, may require revising candidate questions or conclusions as investigation proceeds, coupling problem formulation with proof development. We present PACE, a research-proof agent that supports this process through a structured research loop that selects mathematical objectives and develops or challenges candidate mechanisms. The whole prover constructs proofs from these mechanisms, and an independent verifier checks them against the original target. Evidence-tracking memory stores assumptions and dependencies arising during research and marks evidence for revalidation when a candidate or condition changes. translated_title: PACE：面向自适应猜想探索的研究证明智能体
translated_abstract: 许多数学研究智能体专注于解决具有固定陈述的问题。然而，猜想研究，尤其是应用数学中的猜想研究，可能需要随着研究推进而修改候选问题或结论，从而将问题表述与证明发展耦合在一起。我们提出了PACE，一个研究-证明智能体，它通过一个结构化的研究循环来支持这一过程：该循环选择数学目标，并发展或挑战候选机制。整体证明器从这些机制构造证明，而一个独立的验证器则对照原始目标检查这些证明。证据追踪记忆存储研究过程中产生的假设和依赖关系，并在候选对象或条件发生变化时标记相关证据以供重新验证。这种记忆支持任务特定的上下文组合，使已检验的前提、探索性材料和未解决的义务彼此清晰区分。
tldr: PACE是一个将问题表述与证明发展相耦合的研究证明智能体，通过结构化研究循环、独立验证器和证据追踪记忆，实现对数学猜想研究过程中候选结论的自适应修改与检验。
en_tdlr: PACE is a research-proving agent that couples problem formulation with proof development via a structured research loop, an independent verifier, and evidence-tracking memory, enabling adaptive revision of candidate conjectures during mathematical research.
